description_en: Retrieves information about a specified knowledge base and the current caller’s access role
description_zh: 读取指定知识库的信息及当前调用者的访问角色
name: GetKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en: The stable ID of the target knowledge base, which can be obtained by calling ListKnowledgeBases
parameters.help_zh: 目标知识库的稳定 ID，可通过 ListKnowledgeBases 获取
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

Code.description_en: The business error code. This field may be omitted if the request succeeds. If the request fails, the common error response protocol applies
Code.description_zh: 业务错误代码。成功时可省略；失败遵循公共错误响应协议

Data.description_en: The public configuration information of the target knowledge base
Data.description_zh: 目标知识库的公共配置信息

AccessRole.description_en: The read-only access role of the current caller for the knowledge base. Valid values: OWNER (owner), ADMIN (administrator), and VIEWER (viewer)
AccessRole.description_zh: 当前调用者对知识库的只读访问角色：OWNER 为负责人，ADMIN 为管理员，VIEWER 为查看者

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the knowledge base. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 知识库创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the knowledge base. This field can be empty if it is not set
Description.description_zh: 知识库的描述信息，未设置时可以为空
Description.example: 销售指标、订单及业务制度知识。

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable ID of the knowledge base, which can be used to limit the search scope
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识库的稳定 ID，可用于限定检索范围

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modification time of the knowledge base. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 知识库最近修改时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the knowledge base

Owner.description_en: The DataWorks user ID of the knowledge base owner
Owner.description_zh: 知识库负责人的 DataWorks 用户 ID

Status.description_en: The public status of the knowledge base. This list returns only normal and visible knowledge bases. The value is ACTIVE
Status.description_zh: 知识库公共状态。本列表仅返回正常可见知识库，值为 ACTIVE

Type.description_en: The type of the knowledge base. Valid values: PERSONAL (personal knowledge base) and ENTERPRISE (enterprise knowledge base)
Type.description_zh: 知识库类型：PERSONAL 为个人知识库，ENTERPRISE 为企业知识库

Message.description_en: A human-readable description of the business error. This field may be omitted if the request succeeds. Provide the RequestId when troubleshooting failures
Message.description_zh: 业务错误的可读说明，成功时可省略。失败定位时请同时提供 RequestId

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
